zh: 总分由两部分组成：所有 T 格子的基础分，以及每一对相邻 TT 的额外 1 分，两部分可以分别计算。
基础分按格子独立累加；相邻对在其右端点处统计，就不会重复也不会遗漏。
遍历字符串：当前是 T 就加上对应分数；若当前和前一个都是 T，再加 1。循环以字符串长度为准，输出总和。
en: The score has two parts: the base points of every T cell, and 1 extra point for each adjacent TT pair. Compute them separately.
Base points add up cell by cell; count each adjacent pair at its right end so none is missed or doubled.
Walk over the string: on a T add its points; if the current and previous characters are both T, add 1. Loop over the string's length and print the total.

explanationEn:
## Idea

Add up the points of all T cells, then count the adjacent TT pairs.

## Correctness

Base points are accumulated per cell independently; each adjacent pair is counted only at its right end, so none is missed or counted twice.

## Complexity

O(n) time, O(n) space (including the input).
